info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Enterprise Architecture Configuration API
info.description: The Enterprise Architecture Configuration API allows businesses to modify and refine their enterprise architecture settings. This API provides operations for updating business direction parameters within the architecture framework. Typical consumers include architects, systems administrators, and business analysts who require flexibility in adjusting their enterprise strategies. By enabling precision updates, this API ensures that organizations can effectively align their operational capabilities with their strategic goals.
